description: This file defines a custom exception class 'PersonAttributeTypeLockedException' used in the OpenMRS project, specifically when person attribute types are locked and manipulation is attempted. It extends 'APIException' and provides multiple constructors for different use cases.

classes.name: PersonAttributeTypeLockedException
classes.description: A runtime exception thrown when person attribute types are locked and manipulation is attempted.

methods.name: PersonAttributeTypeLockedException
methods.description: Default constructor setting a standard message indicating the attribute types are locked.

methods.name: PersonAttributeTypeLockedException
methods.description: Constructor allowing a custom message and a cause throwable for chaining exceptions.

methods.name: PersonAttributeTypeLockedException
methods.description: Constructor allowing only a cause throwable, used to chain exceptions without a custom message.
